description: August 16 birthday meaning: Leo decan 3, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 16 birthday falls in Leo, in the third decan, with Sun as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Leo is fixed and fire.

sections.heading: August 16 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Intensity with an inner dimension marks August 16th. Seven, the number of reflection, meets Leo twenty-three degrees along, in the decan Mars sub-rules. The result is often described as a focused, self-contained competitor who analyses every move. Charisma is there, but so is privacy; this birthday tends to reveal itself slowly and on its own terms.

On August 16 the Sun usually sits at about 23° Leo, in the third decan, where Mars is the sub-ruler alongside Sun. The final third of Leo sits under Mars, ruler of Aries, and so mid-to-late August birthdays tend to carry the most forceful version of the sign. Courage, competitiveness and a readiness to defend people or principles are commonly associated with this decan. These Leos often lead from the front and prefer action to ceremony. Mars can make the temper quick and the pride prickly, especially when they feel challenged in public. The same fire gives them stamina for long campaigns. Channelling it into a cause bigger than personal recognition is often where this decan does its most memorable work.

sections.heading: August 16 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 16th reduces as 1 + 6 = 7, giving a birthday number of 7. In the compound, the 1 of the individual meets the 6 of home and responsibility, and the result is the 7's reflective, searching mind. Numerologists sometimes list 16 as a karmic debt number, linked with humility and rebuilding after the collapse of an outdated self-image. Those born on this day are often described as introspective, intuitive and capable of real personal reinvention. The day number is secondary, but in the 16 it frequently marks a rich inner life and a habit of questioning appearances.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one August 16 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on August 16: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 16 is the 228th day of the year (229th in a leap year). By August 23, 7 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Virgo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by August 16, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on August 16 include Madonna (1958), James Cameron (1954) and Charles Bukowski (1920).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 16?
faq.answer: August 16 is Leo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Leo, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 16?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 16 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 16th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 16?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an August 16 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 16?
faq.answer: August 16 is also the birthday of Madonna (1958), James Cameron (1954) and Charles Bukowski (1920). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
